title: Kodera2023: Left/right-hand motor-imagery EEG dataset
description: A left/right-hand motor-imagery EEG dataset from 29 healthy participants recorded at the University of West Bohemia. Participants performed cue-based, single-class imagery of left- or right-hand movement across four runs in one session, with a 4 s trial interval. Data were recorded in BrainVision format and re-released in BIDS format with HED event annotations via MOABB, for brain-computer interface research.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with BrainVision Recorder (BrainProducts) using electrodes placed according to the standard 10-20 montage (Fz, Cz, Pz, F3, F4, P3, P4, C3, C4 in the 9-channel configuration) at a 500 Hz sampling rate. Each recording consisted of one imagery class (left or right hand), with the visual cue onset marked by a BrainVision stimulus marker. Trials were 4 s long and the protocol was offline.
